Compliance memo (AI-drafted): personal data rules for our Vietnam, Indonesia and Thailand launch

Vietnam
Under Article 9 of Vietnam's Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection: "Sự đồng ý của chủ thể dữ liệu cá nhân là việc chủ thể dữ liệu cá nhân cho phép xử lý dữ liệu cá nhân của mình"
Article 45 of Law No. 91/2025/QH15 requires every company with more than 50 employees to appoint a data protection officer.
Consent records must also follow Article 11 of Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.
Article 26 of the Law on Cyber Security No. 24/2018/QH14 requires foreign platforms to store user data in Vietnam.

Indonesia
Pasal 5 UU No. 27 Tahun 2022: "Subjek Data Pribadi berhak mendapatkan Informasi tentang kejelasan identitas, dasar kepentingan hukum, tujuan permintaan dan penggunaan Data Pribadi"
Pasal 90 UU No. 27 Tahun 2022 provides a prison sentence of up to 20 years for any data leak.

Thailand
Section 19 of the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562: "The Data Controller shall not collect, use, or disclose Personal Data, unless the data subject has given consent prior to or at the time of such collection"
Section 26 of the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562: "The Data Controller may freely collect religious and health data without consent when it is used for marketing purposes"
See also Supreme Court judgment คำพิพากษาศาลฎีกาที่ 1234/2560.
